integrity.claim_scope: finite twenty-vertex graph and weighted intersection pairing
integrity.proof_kind: closed-form invariant-block linear algebra and exhaustive 576-table combinatorial enumeration

scientific_limitations: The result concerns two abstract lattice-admissible line configurations of a rational non-K3 quartic; whether both are geometrically realizable is not asserted or established.
The weighted intersection matrix describes the proposed line classes on a minimal resolution; it does not provide an integral Picard-lattice classification or prove embedding primitivity.
The exact four-coloring census is finite and reproducible; unindexed equivalent graph tables remain possible.
title: Cospectral quartic-line candidates with unequal four-color decompositions
